definitions.explanation: To guard or shield from harm.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{壁|かべ}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I built a wall to block the wind.

examples.japanese: {日差|ひざ}しを{防|ふせ}ぐために{帽子|ぼうし}をかぶった。
examples.english: I wore a hat to protect against the sun.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{注意|ちゅうい}する。
examples.english: To be careful in order to prevent accidents.

examples.japanese: {手|て}を{洗|あら}うことで{感染|かんせん}を{防|ふせ}ぐことができる。
examples.english: You can prevent infection by washing your hands.

notes:
{防|ふせ}ぐ is a godan verb meaning to defend against, protect from, or prevent.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜を{防|ふせ}ぐ

SENSE 1 - TO DEFEND/PROTECT:
- {敵|てき}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to defend against enemies
- {風|かぜ}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to block the wind
- {寒|さむ}さを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to protect from cold

SENSE 2 - TO PREVENT:
- {病気|びょうき}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent illness
- {事故|じこ}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent accidents
- {火災|かさい}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent fires
- {犯罪|はんざい}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent crime

RELATED WORDS:
- {防止|ぼうし}する: to prevent (formal noun + suru)
- {予防|よぼう}する: to take precautions against
- {防御|ぼうぎょ}する: to defend (military/formal)
- {防犯|ぼうはん}: crime prevention
